title: Looking west, building cofferdam
description: South of the two west piers, the road goes up the hill past the woodworking building and storage sheds to the cement plant. The causeway used during construction is in the foreground; it was washed out three times in two years. On the west pier base, workers built a cofferdam, some reaching 60 feet below the riverbed. After removing the water from the cofferdams, they installed steel beams and rods to prepare for concrete pouring. (Provincial Archives P155-1549)
